title: Text: DET Alan Trammell ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hey, would I be able to talk to you about Lou, HOF vote whenever you have a few minutes? Know you’re busy and I don’t want to make this into a big deal, just hoping to paint a picture of the disappointment and then give some of my ideas why
Hi Anthony, no reason for me to comment other than it will happen it’s just a matter of when. Thanks, Tram
Thank you for getting back to me
